MCII error 5 — Secure Boot OFF is NOT enough
=============================================

Your PC has Test Mode ON (good) but VBS is still RUNNING.
VBS blocks UNSIGNED kernel drivers. MCII driver is unsigned.

STEP 1 — Disable VBS (admin + reboot)
--------------------------------------
Run:  launch\disable_vbs_mcii.bat

STEP 2 — Memory Integrity (manual check)
-----------------------------------------
Windows Security -> Device security -> Core isolation details
Memory integrity -> OFF

If you use Windows Hello PIN — disable PIN first, then turn Memory integrity OFF.

STEP 3 — Reboot PC

STEP 4 — Install MCII again
----------------------------
Run:  launch\install_mcii.bat

STEP 5 — Test
-------------
  cd f:\Shit\l2bo
  uv run python scripts/test_ib_input.py

Expected:  2. MCII ... OK

Verify VBS is off: Win+R -> msinfo32
  "Virtualization-based security" should say "Not enabled"

If still FAIL — send vendor\MCII\install.log
